name: winclip
description: Clipping local: vídeos largos a shorts verticales con subtítulos y publicación multi-red

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run typecheck:web
